origin: Original fictional bilingual policy and order fixtures; no real accounts or operational personal data.

third_party_exception.origin: LMSYS/MT-Bench public human preferences, pinned four-row first-turn slice
third_party_exception.purpose: Optional actual local Judge calibration, not model training

collection: No live user orders; fictional secrets have DEMO prefixes. No model weights redistributed.
processing: Retain original v1/v2 policy meaning, line spans, candidate order and all nine KA-0 cases. Exact-source verification is limited to authored corpus.
splits: KA-0 diagnostics, KA-4 development cases and KA-7 fault diagnostics stay separate. Four human-labeled English cases are a convenience slice, not a random evaluation sample.
retention: Synthetic published fixtures remain versioned teaching artifacts. Operational lifecycle values are simulated policy, not real deletion from Git history.
limitation: No real-world population fairness, privacy compliance or broad model quality claim. Deleting application data does not unlearn a model.

consented_annotation.source: One real reader, anonymous-use consent recorded on 2026-09-14
consented_annotation.purpose: Four fixed in-domain support labels; not training data
consented_annotation.limitations: One annotator; bilingual outputs share four semantic labels, not eight independent votes
